description:
GOAL: Make `c_pointer` the sole fz spelling for the builtin C pointer type.

SIGNAL:
- source declarations, resource contracts, diagnostics, fixtures, and guides use `c_pointer`
- the old `cpointer` spelling is rejected, rather than retained as a silent alias
- all three execution doors preserve the existing raw pointer ABI behavior

STRATEGY: Rename the builtin resolver spelling and every public reference together; pin the accepted/rejected front-door behavior and retain the existing raw I64 C ABI lane.
title: Normalize FFI c_pointer spelling
